name: Data Constants & Convex Backend
description: Three-file data layer comprising: (1) src/data/tools.ts — typed constant registry of all 11 exemplar.tools tool definitions including slugs, display metadata, accent colors, YouTube embed URLs, and step-by-step CLI instruction sets; (2) convex/schema.ts — Convex schema defining the 'comments' table with a compound index on [page, createdAt]; (3) convex/comments.ts — Convex query and mutation functions for listing and adding comments per page. An optional src/data/types.ts re-exports canonical types for downstream consumption.

functions.name: getToolBySlug
functions.description: Pure lookup function that searches the TOOLS constant array for a ToolDef matching the provided slug string. Returns the matching ToolDef or undefined if no tool has that slug. This is the canonical way to resolve a route parameter to a tool definition.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: The slug string to look up, typically from a React Router route parameter (/:toolSlug). May be any string; non-matching values yield undefined.

preconditions: TOOLS array is initialized and contains exactly 11 entries.
postconditions: If slug matches a ToolSlug variant, returns the corresponding ToolDef with all fields populated.
If slug does not match any ToolSlug variant, returns undefined.
The TOOLS array is not mutated.

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function — performs an array find over the in-memory TOOLS constant.

functions.name: listComments
functions.description: Convex query function that retrieves all comments for a given page slug. Uses the 'by_page' compound index on [page, createdAt] to efficiently filter by page and return results sorted by createdAt in ascending (chronological) order. Returns an array of full CommentDocument objects. Being a Convex query, it is reactive — subscribed clients receive real-time updates when comments are added.

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: The tool slug identifying which page's comments to retrieve. Validated by Convex v.string() arg validator.

validators.error_message: Page slug must be between 1 and 50 characters.

error_cases.name: convex_backend_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The Convex backend is unreachable or the deployment is not running.

error_data.message: Failed to connect to Convex backend.

error_cases.name: invalid_args
error_cases.condition: The page argument fails Convex v.string() validation (e.g., not a string).

error_data.message: Argument validation failed: page must be a string.

preconditions: The 'comments' table exists in the Convex schema with the 'by_page' index defined on ['page', 'createdAt'].
The Convex backend is reachable and the deployment is active.
postconditions: Returns an array of CommentDocument objects where every element has page === args.page.
The returned array is sorted by createdAt in ascending order.
If no comments exist for the given page, returns an empty array.
No data is mutated by this operation.

structured_side_effects.description: Executes an indexed query against the Convex 'comments' table, reading all documents matching the given page slug via the by_page compound index.

performance_budget.complexity: O(k) where k = number of comments for the given page

functions.name: addComment
functions.description: Convex mutation function that inserts a new comment document into the 'comments' table. Sets createdAt to Date.now() at mutation execution time — the caller does not supply a timestamp. The inserted document will be reactively pushed to any clients subscribed to listComments for the same page slug.

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: The tool slug identifying which page this comment belongs to. Validated by Convex v.string().

validators.error_message: Page slug must be between 1 and 50 characters.

inputs.name: author
inputs.description: Display name of the comment author. Validated by Convex v.string().

validators.error_message: Author name must be between 1 and 100 characters.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: The comment text content. Validated by Convex v.string().

validators.error_message: Comment body must be between 1 and 2000 characters.

error_data.message: Argument validation failed: page, author, and body must all be strings.

preconditions: The 'comments' table exists in the Convex schema.
The Convex backend is reachable and the deployment is active.
All three arguments (page, author, body) are non-empty strings.
postconditions: A new document exists in the 'comments' table with the provided page, author, and body fields.
The new document's createdAt field is set to the epoch millisecond timestamp at mutation execution time (Date.now()).
Any reactive subscriptions to listComments for the same page value are notified of the new document.
side_effects: Inserts a new document into the Convex 'comments' table.
Triggers reactive update push to all subscribed listComments clients for the affected page.

structured_side_effects.description: Sends a mutation request to the Convex backend to insert a new document into the 'comments' table.
Inserts a new row with fields {page, author, body, createdAt} into the 'comments' table. This triggers Convex's reactive subscription system to push the update to subscribed clients.

invariants: TOOLS array contains exactly 11 elements, one per tool in the exemplar.tools suite.
Every ToolDef in TOOLS has a unique slug value matching the ToolSlug union.
Every ToolDef in TOOLS has a unique stepNumber in the range 1–11 inclusive.
The tool with slug 'kindex' has videoUrl === undefined; all other 10 tools have a defined videoUrl string.
Every accent color hex in TOOLS is unique and WCAG AA compliant (contrast ratio >= 4.5:1) against a dark background (#0f172a or similar).
TOOL_SLUGS array order matches TOOLS array order and both are readonly.
The Convex 'comments' table schema includes exactly four fields: page (string), author (string), body (string), createdAt (number).
The 'by_page' index is defined on ['page', 'createdAt'] enabling efficient compound queries.
addComment always sets createdAt to Date.now() at mutation execution time — callers never supply this value.
listComments returns results sorted by createdAt ascending for a given page.
getToolBySlug returns undefined for any string not in the ToolSlug union.
Each ToolDef.instructions array contains between 3 and 5 InstructionStep entries inclusive.

data_access.rationale: Reads PUBLIC data: the static in-memory tool registry (slugs, names, descriptions, colors, video URLs, instruction steps) is compile-time constant data with no sensitivity. Reads USER_GENERATED data: listComments queries the Convex 'comments' table which contains user-supplied author names and comment bodies. Writes USER_GENERATED data: addComment inserts rows containing user-provided author and body text into the Convex 'comments' table.

side_effects.rationale: listComments performs a Convex indexed query reading all comment documents matching a given page slug, returning author names and comment bodies authored by end users.
addComment inserts a new document into the Convex 'comments' table containing a user-supplied author name and body text, plus a server-generated createdAt timestamp.

authority.rationale: This component is the single source of truth for the static tool definition registry (tool_registry domain) — all 11 tool slugs, metadata, accent colors, and instructions originate here. It also owns the comments domain: the Convex schema, table definition, index, and all read/write functions for user-submitted comments.
